mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns, as lower rates reduce the cost of capital and increase equity valuations.
failure_condition: The correlation between FEDFUNDS and 20-day forward returns is positive (i.e., higher FEDFUNDS levels are associated with higher returns) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE) combined with weak consumer spending (RSAFS) signals a dual economic stress in the labor market and consumption, causing negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: The interaction term (UNRATE * RSAFS) has a positive coefficient in a regression of 20-day returns, or negative returns occur in less than 40% of instances where UNRATE > 4.0 and RSAFS < 650000.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 300) signals persistent price pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns as the central bank maintains restrictive policy.
failure_condition: In periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases when CPIAUCSL > 300.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 60-day returns as corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: The correlation between HOUST and 60-day forward returns is negative (i.e., higher HOUST levels are associated with lower returns) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals a contraction in manufacturing and supply chain activity, causing negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns due to immediate economic concerns.
failure_condition: When INDPRO falls below 100, the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) combined with falling industrial production (INDPRO) signals a broad economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns as both consumer and business activity weaken.
failure_condition: The interaction term (HOUST * INDPRO) has a positive coefficient in a regression of 20-day returns, or negative returns occur in less than 40% of instances where HOUST < 1400 and INDPRO < 103.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market (UNRATE < 3.5%), strong employment growth (PAYEMS > 157,000) signals robust economic conditions and corporate profitability, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: In periods when UNRATE < 3.5%, the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases when PAYEMS > 157,000.
